The '''Maarka system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Perkell sector/Legends|Perkell sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Maarka]] and an [[Unidentified asteroid field (Maarka)|asteroid field]].<ref name="Milk Run to Maarka!" />
